subsystems.name: Storage medium
subsystems.role: holds the quantum state as a collective excitation rather than as a fragile single atom.
parts: rare-earth-doped crystal (e.g. europium or praseodymium in a yttrium orthosilicate host)
or a laser-cooled cloud of neutral atoms
dopant isotope chosen for long spin coherence

subsystems.name: Light–matter interface
subsystems.role: makes a single photon interact strongly enough with the medium to be absorbed and re-emitted efficiently.
parts: high-finesse optical cavity or tight-focusing optics

subsystems.name: Control and pulse generation
subsystems.role: writes, holds and recalls the state with precisely shaped laser pulses.

subsystems.name: Cryogenic and shielding environment
subsystems.role: suppresses thermal noise and stray fields that destroy the stored coherence.
parts: cryostat or magneto-optical trap vacuum system

subsystems.name: Readout and verification
subsystems.role: proves the released state really is quantum, not a classical copy.

subsystems.name: Network interface
subsystems.role: connects the memory to a fibre link and to neighbouring nodes.
parts: quantum frequency conversion to telecom wavelengths

buildSteps.title: Prepare the medium
buildSteps.detail: A rare-earth-doped crystal is grown with controlled dopant concentration and a single isotope to give narrow optical and spin transitions, or atoms are cooled and trapped in vacuum.

buildSteps.title: Engineer the absorption line
buildSteps.detail: Optical pumping and tailored laser sequences carve a narrow, precisely spaced absorbing structure (such as an atomic frequency comb) into the broadened transition.

buildSteps.title: Build the optical interface
buildSteps.detail: The medium is placed in a cryostat with field coils, shielding and a cavity or lens system that shrinks the optical mode volume onto it.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate write pulses
buildSteps.detail: The laser is locked to the transition and the write pulse is shaped so the incoming photon is absorbed with near-unit probability.

buildSteps.title: Transfer and hold
buildSteps.detail: The excitation is moved into a long-lived spin state and decoupled from its noisy surroundings with echo or dynamical-decoupling pulse trains.

buildSteps.title: Recall and detect
buildSteps.detail: A read pulse converts the stored excitation back into a photon, which is collected and detected.

buildSteps.title: Measure fidelity and efficiency
buildSteps.detail: The retrieved state is compared with the input, and fidelity must exceed what any classical measure-and-prepare device could achieve.

buildSteps.title: Link to a network
buildSteps.detail: Photons are converted to telecom wavelengths, sent down fibre, and entangled with a second node through a heralded swapping protocol.

prerequisites.tech: Narrow-line rare-earth materials and cold-atom traps
prerequisites.why: narrow transitions are what allow long storage times and high-fidelity recall, and they are now routinely produced.
heralded operation means every attempt hinges on detecting one photon without noise.
memories work best at visible or near-infrared wavelengths, while fibres demand telecom wavelengths.
memories are only useful in a network if two distant links can be joined into one.
most solid-state memories need cooling, and the equipment must eventually be deployable outside a laboratory.

pathway.milestone: laboratory memories storing single photons with efficiencies above 90 percent and fidelity clear of the classical bound
pathway.unlocks: the core component of a quantum repeater, verified in isolation.

pathway.milestone: two distant memories whose contents are entangled, beating direct photon transmission over the same fibre length
pathway.unlocks: a working elementary link in a repeater chain.

pathway.milestone: metropolitan testbeds with several memory nodes and multiplexed modes running in parallel
pathway.unlocks: synchronised quantum networks and device-independent protocols between cities.

pathway.milestone: repeater chains spanning hundreds of kilometres and memory buses inside modular quantum computers
pathway.unlocks: entanglement distribution at continental scale and scalable quantum hardware.
